<document id="security-scams">
CommonˆscamsˆtoˆwatchˆforˆTheseˆareˆtheˆscamsˆweˆseeˆmostˆoften.ˆKnowingˆthemˆisˆtheˆbestˆprotection.ˆ##ˆFakeˆbankˆcallsˆSomeoneˆcallsˆclaimingˆtoˆbeˆfromˆTallowbrook'sˆfraudˆteam.ˆTheyˆknowˆsomeˆofˆyourˆdetailsˆandˆsayˆyourˆaccountˆisˆatˆrisk.ˆTheyˆaskˆforˆaˆcodeˆorˆaskˆyouˆtoˆmoveˆmoney.ˆThat'sˆaˆscam.ˆWeˆneverˆdoˆthat.ˆ##ˆImpersonatingˆsomeoneˆyouˆknowˆAˆmessageˆfromˆaˆ"familyˆmember"ˆwithˆaˆnewˆnumberˆwhoˆurgentlyˆneedsˆmoney.ˆCallˆthemˆonˆtheirˆoldˆnumberˆbeforeˆyouˆsendˆanything.ˆ##ˆMarketplaceˆandˆrentalˆscamsˆAˆsellerˆasksˆyouˆtoˆpayˆbyˆBrookPayˆorˆwireˆinsteadˆofˆaˆprotectedˆpaymentˆmethod,ˆoftenˆforˆaˆdealˆthatˆseemsˆtooˆgood.ˆBrookPayˆandˆwiresˆcan'tˆbeˆreversed.ˆ##ˆJobˆandˆinvestmentˆscamsˆSomeoneˆoffersˆeasyˆmoneyˆforˆmovingˆfundsˆthroughˆyourˆaccount,ˆorˆpromisesˆguaranteedˆreturns.ˆMovingˆmoneyˆforˆothersˆcanˆgetˆyourˆaccountˆclosed.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆyou'veˆbeenˆscammed,ˆmessageˆusˆstraightˆaway.ˆTheˆsoonerˆweˆknow,ˆtheˆbetterˆtheˆchanceˆofˆstoppingˆorˆrecoveringˆtheˆmoney,ˆalthoughˆweˆcan'tˆpromiseˆthat.ˆSeeˆ"Ifˆyouˆsentˆmoneyˆtoˆaˆscammer".ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="check-deposit-availability">
WhenˆcheckˆdepositsˆareˆavailableˆOnceˆyourˆcheckˆdepositˆisˆaccepted,ˆhere'sˆwhenˆyouˆcanˆuseˆtheˆmoney.ˆ##ˆStandardˆavailabilityˆ-ˆTheˆfirstˆ$225ˆisˆavailableˆtheˆnextˆbusinessˆday.ˆ-ˆTheˆrestˆisˆavailableˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆNewˆaccountsˆForˆaccountsˆopenˆlessˆthanˆ30ˆdays,ˆweˆmayˆholdˆcheckˆdepositsˆforˆupˆtoˆ7ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆLongerˆholdsˆWeˆmayˆalsoˆholdˆaˆcheckˆlongerˆifˆit'sˆunusuallyˆlargeˆforˆyourˆaccount,ˆifˆtheˆcheckˆlooksˆaltered,ˆorˆifˆitˆhasˆbeenˆreturnedˆbefore.ˆTheˆappˆshowsˆtheˆreleaseˆdateˆonˆtheˆdeposit.ˆ##ˆReturnedˆchecksˆIfˆtheˆcheckˆbouncesˆafterˆtheˆmoneyˆwasˆmadeˆavailable,ˆweˆtakeˆtheˆamountˆbackˆfromˆyourˆbalance.ˆThere'sˆnoˆreturnedˆitemˆfee.ˆDepositsˆmadeˆonˆaˆweekendˆorˆbankˆholidayˆcountˆasˆreceivedˆonˆtheˆnextˆbusinessˆday.ˆ##ˆCheckˆtheˆstatusˆTapˆtheˆdepositˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeedˆtoˆseeˆwhetherˆit'sˆpending,ˆavailableˆorˆreturned.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="security-scam-payment">
IfˆyouˆsentˆmoneyˆtoˆaˆscammerˆIfˆyouˆsentˆaˆBrookPayˆpayment,ˆaˆtransferˆorˆaˆwireˆandˆthenˆrealizedˆitˆwasˆaˆscam,ˆtellˆusˆrightˆaway.ˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆcanˆdoˆSupportˆwillˆpassˆyourˆreportˆtoˆourˆFraudˆteam.ˆThey'llˆcontactˆtheˆreceivingˆaccountˆorˆbankˆandˆtryˆtoˆrecoverˆtheˆmoney.ˆBrookPayˆpaymentsˆcan'tˆbeˆreversed,ˆsoˆrecoveryˆdependsˆonˆtheˆmoneyˆstillˆbeingˆinˆtheˆotherˆaccount.ˆWeˆcan'tˆpromiseˆtoˆgetˆitˆback.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆincludeˆ-ˆTheˆpaymentˆandˆtheˆdateˆ-ˆHowˆyouˆwereˆcontactedˆandˆwhatˆyouˆwereˆtoldˆ-ˆScreenshotsˆofˆmessages,ˆandˆanyˆnames,ˆnumbersˆorˆwebsitesˆ##ˆProtectˆyourselfˆnowˆ-ˆIfˆyouˆsharedˆaˆpasswordˆorˆcode,ˆchangeˆyourˆpassword.ˆ-ˆDon'tˆsendˆmoreˆmoneyˆtoˆgetˆtheˆfirstˆpaymentˆback.ˆThat'sˆaˆcommonˆsecondˆscam.ˆ-ˆReportˆtheˆscamˆtoˆtheˆpolice.ˆ##ˆCardˆpaymentsˆareˆdifferentˆIfˆyouˆpaidˆaˆscammerˆbyˆcard,ˆyouˆmayˆbeˆableˆtoˆdisputeˆtheˆpurchaseˆwithˆtheˆmerchant.ˆSeeˆ"Disputingˆaˆpurchaseˆwithˆaˆmerchant".ˆTheˆFraudˆteamˆusuallyˆrepliesˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
